# Job Kiprotich Busienei

> Software engineer in Nairobi, Kenya. Builds help desk and workflow software —

> tools. Currently a Software Engineer at SafariDesk. Open to remote roles.

## Current role

**Software Engineer, SafariDesk** — March 2025 to present. SafariDesk is his
employer's product, not his own: a help desk and ticketing SaaS with a shared
inbox, SLA controls, email-to-ticket intake, knowledge base, customer portal, and
cloud plus self-hosted Docker deployments. He is one of twenty contributors and,
because it is a small startup, owns large pieces of it.

Measured contribution: 461 of 2,027 commits across the two main repositories —
second of twenty contributors on both. Backend is Django and PostgreSQL (61,903
lines); frontend is React and TypeScript (89,312 lines).

Work includes per-tenant branded transactional email, a unified real-time event
broadcast layer, OAuth token refresh for Google and Microsoft mailboxes,
multi-tenant data isolation fixes, the knowledge base and public help centre, and
a shared form component library.

He is also the largest contributor (122 of 241 commits) to **Safe Redact**, a
sibling product: a C# WPF desktop application on .NET 10 (94,532 lines) that
detects and removes personal information from documents, images, audio and video
using local ONNX models with DirectML GPU acceleration.

## Previous

**Kenya Power (KPLC), ICT & Telecommunication Division, Nakuru** — industrial
attachment, January to July 2024. Frontline ICT support: Windows user support,
service desk monitoring and resolution-time reporting, LAN/WAN and Cisco
equipment, VHF/HF radio systems, equipment inventory. Built an internal device
check-in and check-out system.

## Education

Computer Programming — 60 semester credits, 3.10 GPA — by SpanTran / The
Evaluation Company, a NACES member, in June 2026.

Note for accuracy: the credential held is a Kenyan Diploma. The Associate of
Science is a US equivalency determination by an external evaluator, not a degree
awarded to him.

Line counts below are counted from source, excluding dependencies, build output
and vendored third-party code.

### Professional (SafariDesk — employer's products, his contribution stated)

- **SafariDesk** — help desk and ticketing SaaS. Django, React, TypeScript,

  94,532 lines; 122 of 241 commits, largest contributor.

  React, Python. 7,454 lines; 17 of 41 commits.

### Personal

- **SOVAS** — multi-portal learning management system with five role-based
  portals (student, teacher, institution, admin, marketing). Django, React,
  Docker, Caddy. 44,468 lines across 457 files.
- **YouTube Agent** — zero-budget multi-organisation YouTube automation:
  topic to script to render to upload, with per-org branding, content calendars,
  analytics and voice benchmarking. Python, Remotion. 32,313 lines.
- **Explainer Video Generator** — faceless explainer pipeline, mechanism-driven.
  Python, Remotion. 24,955 lines.
- **Syvella** — automated explainer video pipeline with word-synchronised
  captions. Node.js, Remotion. 19,242 lines.
- **Boval** — multi-tenant booking platform with branded booking pages, embed
  widget, plan-based billing, multi-currency geo pricing. FastAPI, PostgreSQL,
  Next.js, Docker. 19,187 lines, sole author.
- **Agentic Personal Assistant** — voice-first multi-agent platform with local
  models. Python, React, Whisper, Ollama, Temporal. 17,276 lines.
- **SWE** — sprint-based AI software house: agents plan, split and review work.
  Python. 15,617 lines.
- **Ellie** — local-first meeting notetaker for Windows and Android. C#, Windows
  App SDK, .NET MAUI, local whisper and llama.cpp with a Vulkan build. 15,019
  lines across 12 projects. Ships signed MSIX, APK and Google Play bundle.
- **Vision** — proactive AI voice assistant that calls on a schedule and
  remembers past conversations. FastAPI, LiveKit, pgvector, Redis, NATS,
  Next.js, Flutter. 15,018 lines.
- **SwiftX** — teen driver safety and ride-hailing: NestJS API, driver and
  parent React Native apps, Next.js admin. 11,652 lines.
- **Nyukiwatch** — offline-first apiary management. Caretakers log hive
  check-ins with photo and voice note; apiarists record inspections (queen
  sighted, brood pattern, action taken). Fastify, PostgreSQL, MinIO. 10,288
  lines with idempotent offline sync.
- **ASIZ** — document intelligence with OCR ingestion, sector classification and
  real-time voice consultation. FastAPI, React Native, PaddleOCR, LiveKit.
  9,919 lines.
- **Multiplayer Board Game Portal** — real-time Monopoly played across a TV and
  players' phones, joined by QR code. NestJS, Socket.IO, Prisma. 6,151 lines.
- **Ambient Scenery Video Generator** — hour-long scenery videos with layered
  asset fallback. Python, FFmpeg. 2,175 lines.
- **MSME Management System** — inventory, sales, expenses and analytics for
  small businesses. Flask, SQLite, Chart.js.
  https://msme-management-system.onrender.com/
- **Device Check-In System** — equipment loan tracking built at Kenya Power.

- **Charge Monitor** — Windows and Android battery notifier. C#, .NET.
